prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd academic semesters according to the study plan (compulsory for MBBA).

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the basics of electrical engineering.

Incorporate subject-specific features of electrical engineering such as modeling, representation in equivalent circuits, function diagrams, flowcharts, and block diagrams, as well as system considerations into didactic concepts.
Compare professional concepts and methods for teaching and learning.
Systematize the taught methods for teaching and learning and select them appropriately for content, problems, and target groups.
Formulate and justify goals, content, and standards according to the training objective (e.g., vocational basic school year, vocational schools, higher vocational schools).
Structure technical content in didactic contexts in a career-oriented manner and process it within the framework of company tasks.
Formulate and justify goals and content for further training and continuing education measures against the background of operational requirements.
Use transparent performance controls for vocational didactic concepts.
Select exemplary content for heterogeneous learning groups, elementarize it, and arrange it in the curriculum.
Select suitable media and assess and use them with regard to their specific deployment conditions and effects in the teaching and learning process.

syllabus_topics: Didactic foundations of vocational specializations (including learning field concept in mechanical engineering professions, company assignments, extracurricular learning environments)

Theories, models, methods, and media (including historical, current, and future developments in the mechanical engineering professional field, problem-solving strategies in action-oriented teaching, use of modern communication and presentation techniques, educational goals and standards, framework curricula and guidelines of the state of NRW, diagnostic procedures)
Historical, current, and future developments in the mechanical engineering professional field
Learning field concept in mechanical engineering professions
Framework curricula and guidelines of the state of NRW
assessment_rules: The module examination must be passed and qualified participation in the courses must be achieved for credit points to be awarded. The specific form of the examination (oral or written assignment) will be announced by the respective lecturer within the first three weeks of the lecture period. The duration for the oral exam is 30-45 minutes or approx. 40,000 characters for the written assignment.
